name: ImageClearRect
description: Clears the specified rectangle by filling it with the background color of the current drawing surface.
syntax: ImageClearRect( object image, number x, number y, number width, number height )

params.name: image
params.description: The image on which this operation is performed.

params.name: x
params.description: The X coordinate of the rectangle to clear.

params.name: y
params.description: The Y coordinate of the rectangle to clear.

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the rectangle to clear.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the rectangle to clear.
